comment: This project serves the static foundation site at /.
The store is a separate Next.js app (repo folder `shop/`) deployed as its own
Vercel project. The rewrite below proxies /shop/* to it so the store keeps the
address keepherlightalive.com/shop instead of moving to a subdomain.
SETUP — once only, in the Vercel dashboard:
1. New Project -> same repo -> Root Directory: shop
HYGRAPH_TOKEN     = the READ-ONLY token (not the delete-capable one)
3. Copy that project's production domain and replace SHOP_DEPLOYMENT_HOST below.
Until step 3 is done this rewrite points nowhere and /shop keeps serving the old
